steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Setting up the unique app name and package namespace for AudioFX Studio.

steps.title: Define Project Build Scripts
steps.description: Create the root build.gradle configurations matching Java 17, Gradle 8.5, and AGP 8.3.2 standards.

steps.title: Configure Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Declare custom package properties, standard launch screen, and safe system themes within AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Construct Native User Interface Layout
steps.description: Design the graphical layout in activity_main.xml, defining Sound FX Pads, Synthesizer controls, progress loader, and the custom history listing.

steps.title: Initialize UI Widgets and Event Callbacks
steps.description: Wire buttons, seekbars, checkbox settings, and text displays inside the MainActivity codebase.

steps.title: Develop Audio Synthesis Mathematical Oscillators
steps.description: Implement raw byte tone generation using continuous phase calculators to generate clean retro sounds (laser, siren, jump, coin).

steps.title: Establish Async AudioTrack Player Workers
steps.description: Write safe background threading processes to play generated sample bytes through native AudioTrack streams without pausing the main UI thread.

steps.title: Implement Simulated Audio Synthesis Loader Delay
steps.description: Create a modern visual circular progress bar and handler routine simulating audio rendering delay when requested by the user.

steps.title: Build Persistent Playback History Logging
steps.description: Develop automatic data persistence to save and read the playback history across restarts using SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic History View Adapter
steps.description: Build layout generator functions in Java to render clean historical list rows featuring custom tone details and direct Replay trigger events.

steps.title: Verify State Cleansers
steps.description: Provide users with options to wipe preferences and completely reset the log container.

steps.title: Building AudioFX Studio
steps.description: Compiling resources, validating Java syntax compliance, and assembling final APK build output.
